(26) in scaled momentum-position coordinates; verified det M=1 by exact identity A²+BC=4D², and independently factored tr(M(t)M(s))±2 with multivariate exact polynomial arithmetic. In the open square (0,sqrt(8))², Q=s²t²−8(s+t)²+192>0 by negative partial derivatives and zero corner limit, so trace<2. The sign of Δ=F(s,t)F(t,s) is therefore equivalent to strict elliptic/hyperbolic 2x2 symplectic classification. Boundary trace −2 has Jordan growth except P=−I; monotonic positive off-diagonal magnitude ratio enforces s=t=s0. Substituting st=4 makes both F factors negative. Antisymmetric expansion near s0 gives tr P=−2−gamma²δ²+O(δ^4) and log spectral radius=gamma|δ|+O(|δ|³). Checked rational stable/unstable witnesses and exact identities; proof handles all continuous parameters.
